documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Clarification sought from Oracle Financial Services Software Ltd
Intimation Of Grant Of Options Under OFSS Stock Plan 2014

analysis.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software reported a consolidated revenue of ₹ 76.7 billion for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, representing a 12% increase year-on-year, while net income rose 11% to ₹ 26.4 billion. The company maintained strong financial discipline with an operating margin of 44% and a net margin of 34%. Management highlighted an acceleration of its AI-led innovation agenda and expanded its cloud services portfolio for the banking industry during the year. Additionally, the Board declared two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26. Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of ₹68.5 billion for the financial year 2025, representing a 7% increase over the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: The business landscape during the financial year continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends, which led to demand challenges in the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that banks are under intense pressure to deliver digital delight at scale while complying with regulations at the lowest possible cost.
demand_outlook.quote: With an increasingly tech savvy customer base which is spoilt for choice, banks are under intense pressure to deliver “digital delight” at scale with complete compliance to regulations and at the lowest possible cost.

demand_outlook.claim: Banks are increasingly seeking solutions on a new architecture that adapts to rapid change and is accessible on the cloud.
demand_outlook.quote: Banks are increasingly looking at solutions delivered on a new architecture which is adaptable to rapid change and is available on the cloud.

capex_expansion.claim: The company significantly expanded its cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with the launch of five new cloud services.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we significantly expanded our cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with the launch of Oracle Banking Retail Lending Servicing Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Collections Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Cash Management Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Supply Chain Management Cloud Service, and Oracle Banking Trade Finance Cloud Service.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained strong financial discipline, achieving an operating margin of 44% for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
margins_costs.quote: We also continued to maintain strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44%, reflecting the Company's consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: The net margin remained strong at 34% for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
margins_costs.quote: Net income rose to ₹ 26.4 billion, reflecting an 11% increase year-on-year, while the net margin remained strong at 34%.

margins_costs.claim: The operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% compared to 42% in the last financial year.
margins_costs.quote: We continued to maintain a strong financial discipline while driving the growth, and our operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% as compared to 42% in the last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained a track record of consistent high profitability metrics among the best in the industry.
margins_costs.quote: It was also notable that we posted double digit growth across all the lines of business. We are proud that we have maintained a track record of delivering consistent high profitability metrics which are amongst the best in our industry.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world which are a testimony to the excellence of our products through continuing R&D, our track record of delivering high quality implementations, and providing reliable support.

orders_capacity.claim: Fiscal year 2024 license wins reached $137 million, which is the highest ever for the company and a 44% growth over the last fiscal.
orders_capacity.quote: The fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M – highest ever for the Company, registering a 44% growth over last fiscal.

orders_capacity.claim: Leading global banks launched programs to revamp their global payment technologies across over 50 countries on the company's IT solutions.
orders_capacity.quote: Leading global banks launched programs to revamp their global payment technologies across over 50 countries on our IT solutions.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a landmark deal with The Navy Federal Credit Union, USA to modernize retail systems on the Oracle Banking Cloud offering.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company won a landmark deal with The Navy Federal Credit Union, USA to modernize their retail systems on our Oracle Banking Cloud offering.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a first interim dividend of ₹ 130 per equity share and a second interim dividend of ₹ 270 per equity share of ₹ 5 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company ("the Board") declared 1st interim dividend of ₹ 130 per equity share and 2nd interim dividend of ₹ 270 per equity share of ₹ 5 each on October 17, 2025 and April 22, 2026, respectively, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per share for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: On the strength of the performance, the Board was pleased to declare an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per share for the financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not carry any debt and is not required to obtain a credit rating.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company does not carry any debt and is not required to obtain a credit rating.

risks_headwinds.claim: The business landscape was driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fiscal year 2024 encountered several uncertainties including geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, bank failures in the western world, and technology shifts.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including continued and expanding geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, highly visible failures of some banks in the western world, and tectonic technology shifts with increasing usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and machine learning (ML).

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation, and maintaining the highest standards of governance.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation and maintaining the highest standards of governance.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
